status: Prepared for root ordinary Git retention; this preparation does not delete files or update any reference.
authorization_scope: Exactly the eight administrative compressed download/extraction receipts listed below. All scientific sources, original requests, parameters, inputs, and other results are retained.

hash_scope.receipt_gzip_sha256: null means no existing whole SHA-256 was obtained from the bounded small records; not recomputed and not inferred.
hash_scope.raw_receipt_sha256: null; no receipt JSON was decompressed or read.
hash_scope.git_blob: Exact existing Git object identity from directory metadata at fixed_restore_commit.
hash_scope.source_sha256: Computed only for complete small text source, workflow, request and explanatory note files actually fetched.
hash_scope.archive_sha256: Original pinned ZIP identity from the complete adapter and historical workflow; distinct from receipt hashes.

complete_fixed_parameters.credential_transport: GITHUB_TOKEN environment only; no command-line credentials
complete_fixed_parameters.output: fresh absolute nonsymlink child below RUNNER_TEMP; existing directory rejected

same_kind_prior_retention.scope: Same kind of administrative download receipt. Its old54 hashes, removed paths and prior checks are not substituted for these actual41 files.

recovery_semantics.exact_original_bytes: Restore each path from fixed_restore_commit or the recorded Git blob; this does not require an available Actions artifact.
recovery_semantics.regeneration: The complete original request, workflow, adapter, kernel, publication source and argv remain at the recorded immutable source commits. If the original artifact is still available, its downloader can regenerate an administrative receipt after exact ZIP verification.
recovery_semantics.volatile_receipt_fields: Actual download metadata, timestamps, run identity and absolute temporary paths can differ on a later download. Re-running is not promised to reproduce the historical receipt bytes; exact original bytes come from Git.

objects.receipt_sha256_status: Not supplied by the bounded small records consulted; compressed and uncompressed receipt bytes were not read.

variable_scope.GITHUB_WORKSPACE: actual checked-out repository path in that original Actions job
variable_scope.RUNNER_TEMP: actual private temporary root in that original Actions job
variable_scope.GITHUB_TOKEN: environment-only GitHub Actions token; no credential value retained

            --run-id 43622149326 --artifact-id 14124209116 \
            --artifact-name visible-mainline-rawcell0steps-43622149326-1 \
            --expected-size 349636774 \
            --expected-sha256 356d9d81959739a22e9347d7ceba6fd4880ad61db70dca73096a4c5b71dc73a8 \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/actual41-step-capture-input-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}"
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/actual41-step-capture-input-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/_pinned_public_artifact_receipt.json" "$VISIBLE_OUT/actual41-artifact-fetch-receipt.json"

        run: |
          python -u "$VISIBLE_COMPUTATIONS/root_20261114_publish_actions.py" \
            --results "$VISIBLE_OUT" --lane "${{ matrix.lane }}"
